# GBMC Healthcare Scholarly Commons

> An institutional research repository preserving and sharing medical scholarship from Greater Baltimore Medical Center's clinical departments, research centers, and faculty.

GBMC Healthcare Scholarly Commons is a digital repository built on the bepress Digital Commons platform that enables GBMC clinicians, researchers, and staff to deposit, preserve, and disseminate peer-reviewed publications, research findings, and scholarly works. The repository supports GBMC's mission to advance medical knowledge and institutional visibility while providing open access to healthcare research.

## Getting Started

- [GBMC Healthcare Scholarly Commons](https://scholarlycommons.gbmc.org): Homepage for the GBMC Healthcare Scholarly Commons institutional research repository
- [About Institutional Repositories](https://scholarlycommons.gbmc.org/about.html): Overview of GBMC Healthcare Scholarly Commons mission, purpose, and role in preserving medical research
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://scholarlycommons.gbmc.org/faq.html): Answers to common questions about repository submissions, OCR, file formatting, and account management

## Submit and Manage Research

- [Submit Your Research](https://scholarlycommons.gbmc.org/submit_research.html): Comprehensive guide for submitting medical research, publications, and scholarly works to GBMC Scholarly Commons
- [Please Log In](https://scholarlycommons.gbmc.org/cgi/myaccount.cgi): User authentication and account login for GBMC Scholarly Commons contributors and administrators

## Browse and Discover Research

- [Browse by Research Unit, Center, or Department](https://scholarlycommons.gbmc.org/communities.html): Navigate GBMC research units, clinical centers, and departments to discover organizational scholarship
- [Browse by Author](https://scholarlycommons.gbmc.org/authors.html): Alphabetical index of GBMC researchers and their publications in the Scholarly Commons
- [Authors and Works by Discipline](https://scholarlycommons.gbmc.org/do/discipline_browser/disciplines): Browse medical research and author works organized by academic discipline and specialty
- [Browse Journals and Peer-Reviewed Series](https://scholarlycommons.gbmc.org/peer_review_list.html): Access peer-reviewed journals and series published through GBMC, including JCHIMP
- [Most Recent Additions](https://scholarlycommons.gbmc.org/recent_additions.html): View recently deposited medical research publications and scholarly works in the repository

## Repository Metrics and Analytics

- [Activity by Year](https://scholarlycommons.gbmc.org/activity.html): Repository statistics and scholarly output metrics tracking GBMC research productivity over time

## Support and Notifications

- [Contact Us](https://scholarlycommons.gbmc.org/contact.html): Contact information for GBMC Scholarly Commons support team and the John E. Savage Medical Library
- [Custom Email Notifications and RSS](https://scholarlycommons.gbmc.org/announcements.html): Subscribe to email alerts and RSS feeds for updates on new research deposits and repository announcements

## Optional

- [Accessibility Statement](https://scholarlycommons.gbmc.org/accessibility.html): WCAG 2.1 and Section 508 accessibility compliance statement for the repository
- [The red face: atopic dermatitis](https://scholarlycommons.gbmc.org/internal_med/144): Medical article on atopic dermatitis by Y M. Mirensky in the dermatology collection
